title: APP fraud reimbursement: the evidence after one year
discussion_signal: The post relays the independent-evaluation result that APP reimbursement was followed by an estimated £73 million annual fall in in-scope Faster Payments losses and points toward unresolved-claim and investment-scam reporting questions. It is a professional interpretation of the evaluation, not an independent causal replication or recipient-level outcome.
linked_research_question: How are policy-effect estimates translated into professional expectations about unresolved claims, scope, and the next measurement regime?
limits: The post is not the evaluation's primary technical report
It does not identify individual victims, reimbursements, or provider-specific outcomes
Its interpretation cannot establish the policy's causal effect beyond the underlying evaluation
